patthana16.95:1.1: saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassana appaṭigho na saraṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā cha.
patthana16.95:2.1: anidassana appaṭighaṃ araṇaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā na sanidassana sappaṭigho na araṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana16.95:4.1: sanidassana sappaṭigho araṇo dhammo na sanidassana sappaṭighassa araṇassa dhammassa ārammaṇa paccayena paccayo.
patthana16.95:6.1: (yathā kusalattike pañhāvārassa anulomampi paccaniyampi anulomapaccanīyampi paccaniyānulomampi gaṇitaṃ, evaṃ gaṇetabbaṃ.) anulomapaccanīya tikaduka paṭṭhānaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
